item.tib: khro mchog 'dus pa sde brgyad 'byung po spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las drag po'i sbyin sreg snang srid rab 'bar
item.coloph: zhes che mchog rta mgrin las kyi kha tshar las drag po'i sbyin sreg snang srid rab 'bar zhes bya ba 'di nyid mdo khams smad kyi gnas mchog brag dkar bya rgod gsang ba'i mdun zhol brag nyi ma rang shar gyi g.yas zur nor bu rdzong gi zhes bya ba gsang lung las rta mgrin gtum chen rol ba'i brag gi byang ngos sked gsang ska rags 'dra ba'i khong seng nas sa stag lo'i zla ba lnga ba'i tshes su kho bo phyogs med kyi rnal 'byor ba gtsug phud rnam rgyal du 'bod pa gsang mtshan du gsang bdag ye shes mgon po zhes bya ba bdag gis dngos grub tu brnyed nas slar mda' chen dkar mo ri khrod du slebs tshe rig 'dzin dmu tsa dra (tra) he'i rnam sprul skyang sprul kun gsal rgyal mtshan can dang rang re'i lha grogs dam pa rnams kyis rab tu bskul ngor dang rten 'brel kun nas mtshungs tshe gter shog brda' don bdun pa can la zhal bshus pa'o dge ba'i bstan dang 'gro la phan par shog
